s: What is the primary goal of the P4 Program of Andhra Pradesh Government?
o: Developing Andhra Pradesh as IT Hub

s: The Swarna Andhra P4 Foundation functions under which department and is concerned with which objective?
x: The Swarna Andhra P4 Foundation is under the Planning Department and is concerned with poverty eradication.

s: What are the well-off mentors who support poor families under Andhra Pradesh's P4 model called?
x: Well-off Margadarsis mentor poor Bangaru Kutumbam families, with the government acting as facilitator.

s: How are Margadarshis chosen under Andhra Pradesh's P4 initiative?
x: Margadarshis are selected voluntarily, with no compulsory government nomination; their role covers guidance and continuous support.

s: What are the poor beneficiary families under Andhra Pradesh's P4 initiative called?
x: Beneficiary families are Bangaru Kutumbalu ('Golden Families'); Margadarshis are the voluntary mentors.

s: What is the full form of P4, launched on Ugadi on 30 March 2025?
x: P4 stands for Public-Private-People Partnership and was launched on 30 March 2025.

s: What is the primary objective of the P4 programme of Andhra Pradesh?
o: Modernisation of the Public Distribution System
x: P4, or Public-Private-People Partnership, aims at the complete eradication of poverty by linking well-off mentors with poor families.

s: With reference to the P4 programme, which pair (level – leadership) is correctly matched?
x: Pawan Kalyan is Vice-Chairperson of the State society; N. Chandrababu Naidu chairs it, District In-charge Ministers coordinate districts and MLAs constituencies.

s: Which 19th-century social reformer, known for selfless service to the poor, was remembered in connection with the P4 initiative?
x: Dokka Seethamma, a 19th-century reformer known for feeding and serving the poor, was remembered in connection with P4.

s: Which of the following correctly describes the P4 programme launched in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Public-Private-Producer Partnership aimed at universal housing
Public-Panchayat-People Partnership aimed at zero unemployment
Private-Public-Political Partnership aimed at zero hunger
Public-Private-People Partnership aimed at zero poverty
x: P4 stands for Public-Private-People Partnership and its goal is zero poverty. The other expansions and objectives do not describe the P4 programme.

s: Who is the Vice-Chairperson of the P4 State society?
x: CM N. Chandrababu Naidu chairs the P4 society and Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan is Vice-Chairperson.

src: APPSC Forest Section Officer (Mains) Paper-I General Studies
s: Which organization signed an MoU with the Andhra Pradesh Government in 2025 to improve health, education and agriculture using technology?
What is the upper limit of free treatment coverage provided under the new hybrid model of NTR Vaidya Seva announced in January 2025 in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Under the hybrid model announced in January 2025, insurance covers the first ₹2.5 lakh and the NTR Vaidya Seva Trust funds treatment up to ₹25 lakh per family for the poor. So the upper limit is ₹25 lakh, not ₹10, ₹15 or ₹20 lakh.

s: Up to what amount per family per year does the Andhra Pradesh Universal Health Policy provide free treatment?
x: The policy gives up to ₹25 lakh per family per year to 1.63 crore families, integrating Ayushman Bharat with NTR Vaidya Seva.

s: Project Sanjeevani, which aims to create digital health records for about 5 crore citizens, has which partners?
o: Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation and TCS
x: Project Sanjeevani's partners are the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation and TCS.

s: Under the Andhra Pradesh Universal Health Policy, who handles claims up to ₹2.5 lakh?
x: Insurance companies handle claims up to ₹2.5 lakh; the NTR Vaidya Seva Trust handles ₹2.5–25 lakh.

s: Under Project Sanjeevani, what is the universal insurance cover per family?
x: The universal cover is ₹2.5 lakh per family; ₹25 lakh relates to NTR Vaidya Seva Trust support for the poor.

s: Under the rationalisation of Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva services, which pair is correctly matched?
x: 197 rare services continue free; 155 treatments were added, taking the total to 324, and the earlier list had been inflated to 3,257.

s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Dr KVNS Anil Kumar – AP State Nodal Officer
Beti Bachao Beti Padhao – launched in 2016
NFHS-5 sex ratio at birth – 929 girls per 1,000 boys
x: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao was launched in 2015, not 2016.

s:
Assertion (A): Sanjeevani is an upcoming public health initiative for curative healthcare.
Reason (R): The Bill Gates Foundation is the partner for Sanjeevani.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
x: Sanjeevani is an upcoming initiative for preventive (not curative) healthcare, so A is false. R is true: the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, with TCS, is its partner.

s: How much did the AP Government release to resume cashless services under NTR Vaidya Seva in April 2025?
x: The Chief Minister released ₹500 crore and cashless services resumed from 8 April 2025; ₹3,500 crore was the total dues and ₹2,000 crore was owed to private hospitals.

s: Since which year have the package rates under NTR Vaidya Seva remained unchanged?
x: NTR Vaidya Seva package rates have been unchanged since 2018, not 2019.

s: APSES 2024–25 coverage operates alongside which national health scheme providing ₹5 lakh per family?
x: APSES 2024–25 runs alongside Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, which gives ₹5 lakh cover per family.

s: Which company leads the consortium that runs the restructured 104 Mobile Medical Unit service?
x: The consortium is led by Bhavya Health Services with SRIT India as partner; it began on a pilot basis.

s: How many confirmatory tests does the restructured 104 Mobile Medical Unit service offer at the doorstep?
x: It offers 47 tests: 20 for all and 27 disease-specific; 35 is persons screened per vehicle a day.

s: Up to what amount can the total coverage under APSES 2024–25 extend?
x: Procedures are covered up to ₹5 lakh per family per year, with total coverage up to ₹25 lakh and no limit for cancer.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Karnataka–Andhra Pradesh decoy operation against female foeticide in Kurnool?
o: It was conducted jointly by the Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh Health Departments
The PCPNDT Act was amended in 2021
The agent was contacted at Guntakal bus stand
x: The PCPNDT Act was amended in 2003, not 2021.

s: Under the Andhra Pradesh Universal Health Policy, within how many hours is pre-authorisation to be given?
x: The policy provides pre-authorisation within 6 hours.

s: How many families are covered under the Andhra Pradesh Universal Health Policy approved in September 2025?
x: It covers 1.63 crore families: 1.43 crore economically weaker and 20 lakh others.

s: Under the Andhra Pradesh Universal Health Policy, who pays claims between ₹2.5 lakh and ₹25 lakh per family?
x: In the hybrid model, insurers pay up to ₹2.5 lakh and the NTR Vaidya Seva Trust pays ₹2.5–25 lakh.

s: How many hospitals are in the network of AP's Universal Health Policy?
x: The policy integrates Ayushman Bharat and NTR Vaidya Seva through 2,493 hospitals.

s: Up to how many weeks of pregnancy does the MTP Act, 1971 (amended 2021) allow termination in certain cases?
x: The amended MTP Act allows up to 24 weeks in certain cases, never for sex selection.

s: At which programme in Visakhapatnam did the CM launch Project Sanjeevani for preventive healthcare?
x: Project Sanjeevani was launched at the Swasth Nari–Sashakt Parivar Abhiyan programme, Visakhapatnam.

s: Who among the following is the Minister of Environment, Forest, Science, and Technology in Andhra Pradesh as of April 2025?
Alongside CMEGP, on what did Andhra Pradesh propose a dedicated policy for MSME clusters?
x: CMEGP is accompanied by a dedicated policy for Common Facility Centres for MSME clusters.

s: Phase 1 temple master plans under Agama Shastra in Andhra Pradesh cover how many temples?
x: Phase 1 master plans cover 23 temples.

s: Temples with annual income above what amount fall in the 6C category in Andhra Pradesh?
x: The present 6C threshold is income above ₹50,000; all 24,538 temples in the category get CCTV coverage.

s: What is the project ceiling for a manufacturing unit under the proposed CMEGP?
x: CMEGP allows ₹75 lakh for manufacturing and ₹25 lakh for service units.

s: The proposed Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme is modelled on which scheme and is intended to encourage whom?
o: The Centre's CFC policy and first-generation entrepreneurs
The Centre's CMEGP and first-generation entrepreneurs
The Centre's PMEGP and certified natural-produce sellers
The Centre's PMEGP and first-generation entrepreneurs
x: CMEGP is modelled on the Centre's PMEGP and is meant for first-generation entrepreneurs. CMEGP itself is the State scheme and the Common Facility Centres policy goes with it, so neither is the central model.

s: To whom does the Stree Shakti scheme of Andhra Pradesh (15 August 2025) give free bus travel?
x: Stree Shakti gives free bus travel to girls, women and transgender persons, with APSRTC reimbursed through zero-fare tickets.

s: In connection with the Stree Shakti scheme, the APSRTC union opposed which model?
x: The union opposed the Gross Cost Contract model and demanded 2,500 buses and 9,000 staff.

s: With reference to PMEGP, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Nature and launch – Centrally Sponsored Scheme, launched 2008
Eligibility – Above 21 years, with an income ceiling
x: PMEGP subsidy is 15%–35% of project cost. It is a Central Sector Scheme (2008) for persons above 18 with no income ceiling, implemented by KVIC.

s: Which of the following Andhra Pradesh schemes is NOT correctly described?
o: Auto Mitra – ₹15,000 to each auto driver
Stree Shakti – free bus travel for women
Talliki Vandanam – support for students' education
x: Anna Canteens provide affordable meals, not farmer support.

s: How many new medical colleges did the AP Cabinet decide to set up through the PPP model?
x: The Cabinet decided to establish 10 new medical colleges through PPP.

s: Which of the following correctly describes Auto Mitra of Andhra Pradesh?
o: A State scheme under the Super Six
x: Auto Mitra is a State Super Six scheme; Annadata Sukhibhava–PM Kisan is for farmers.

s: What change did the Andhra Pradesh Cabinet approve for the public distribution system from 1 June 2025?
o: Fair Price Shops were restored and Mobile Dispensing Units were discontinued.
Mobile Dispensing Units were restored and Fair Price Shops were discontinued.
Fair Price Shops were restored while Mobile Dispensing Units continued without change.
Doorstep delivery was discontinued for senior citizens and persons with disabilities.
x: The Cabinet discontinued Mobile Dispensing Units and restored Fair Price Shops from 1 June 2025. Doorstep delivery continued for senior citizens aged 65+ and persons with disabilities, making the other alternatives incorrect.

s: Who launched the ‘Mana Illu – Mana Lokesh’ initiative for providing permanent land rights to residents on government land in Mangalagiri?
x: Nara Lokesh, the HRD and IT Minister and MLA of Mangalagiri, launched ‘Mana Illu – Mana Lokesh’ to provide permanent land rights, or pattas, to residents on government land. Pawan Kalyan is associated with the ‘Adavi Thalli Baata’ initiative, not this land-patta programme.

s: Under the Matsyakara Sevalo scheme (April 2025), how much did each marine fishermen family receive during the fishing ban?
x: Each family got ₹20,000, up from ₹10,000 under the previous government; the total budget was ₹258 crore.

s: Under the Matsyakara Sevalo scheme in Andhra Pradesh, during which period was the annual fishing ban observed in 2025?
x: The fishing ban under the Matsyakara Sevalo scheme was observed from 15 April to 14 June 2025, a period of approximately 61 days. The tempting alternative of 15 April to 14 July is incorrect because the ban ended on 14 June.

s: From which date does Stree Shakti provide free APSRTC bus travel for women?
x: Free APSRTC bus travel for women under Stree Shakti began on 15 August 2025.

s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Stree Shakti — Free bus travel for women through APSRTC
Divyang Shakti — Free bus travel for all students
Mee Mart — Digital health profiles and ABHA IDs
x: Stree Shakti is an APSRTC initiative providing free bus travel for women from 15 August 2025.

s: Which department is to implement the proposed CMEGP in Andhra Pradesh through District Industries Centres?
x: CMEGP is to be implemented by the Department of MSME, Andhra Pradesh, through District Industries Centres.

s: Annadanam, already available in 7 temples, is being extended to how many major temples in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Adding 16 more temples to the existing 7 brings Annadanam to all 23 major temples.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about rice-card services and Smart Rice Cards in Andhra Pradesh?
o: From 15 May, applicants can message “Hello” to 95523 00009 on WhatsApp Governance
eKYC is exempt for seniors above 70
Smart Rice Cards are issued free of cost
Rice cards were given for the first time to transgender persons
x: The eKYC exemption applies to seniors above 80, not above 70.

s: Which of the following is NOT one of the six rice-card services offered through Village and Ward Secretariats in AP?
x: The six services are new card, bifurcation, change of address, addition and removal of members and surrender; eKYC exemption is a separate provision.

s: Which groups were identified for Antyodaya Anna Yojana cards providing 35 kg of rice?
o: Chenchus, Yanadis and pensioned rural artists
Transgender persons, separated spouses and orphans
SC, ST, BC and EBC operators
x: AAY cards providing 35 kg of rice were identified for Chenchus, Yanadis and pensioned rural artists. The other groups relate to special rice-card eligibility, eKYC exemptions or MDU vehicle ownership.

s: Which of the following is NOT among the beneficiary groups under the Chandranna Vidyut Velugulu programme?
x: The programme's beneficiaries include farming families, small traders and small industries, not large industries.

s: Under Andhra Pradesh's Deepam scheme, beneficiaries get how many free LPG cylinders a year?
x: Deepam provides 3 free LPG cylinders a year.

s: What does the Chandranna Vidyut Velugulu programme aim to provide to rural areas?
x: The programme aims at 24-hour three-phase uninterrupted power for rural areas, not single-phase.

s: What was the statewide allocation for the Chandranna Vidyut Velugulu programme?
x: The statewide allocation was ₹9,139 crore; ₹50 crore was for Nellore Rural.

s: What did Phase 3 of Deepam-2 propose for the subsidy?
o: Credited in advance to beneficiaries' accounts
Credited after each refill is delivered
Given as a free cylinder at the doorstep
x: Phase 3 proposed crediting the subsidy in advance to beneficiaries' accounts; Phase 1 had about 99,700 beneficiaries and Phase 2 about 70 lakh registrations.

s: Under Talliki Vandanam, how much is given to mothers per child per year?
x: Talliki Vandanam gives ₹13,000 per child per year to mothers.

s: Where did the Chief Minister launch the Matsyakara Sevalo scheme in April 2025?
x: Matsyakara Sevalo was launched at Budagatlapalem, Etcherla mandal, Srikakulam on 26 April 2025.

s: Which agency implements the Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)?
x: PMEGP, a Central Sector Scheme of 2008, is implemented by KVIC, a statutory body under the KVIC Act, 1956.

s: What does Deepam-2 do for LPG users in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Upgrades 5 kg users to 14.2 kg cylinders
x: Deepam-2 upgrades 5 kg LPG users to 14.2 kg cylinders (23,912 families in 16 districts).

s: For which group were rice cards issued for the first time in Andhra Pradesh in 2025?
x: Rice cards were given for the first time to transgender persons with the Smart Rice Cards.

s: About how many trips were made under Stree Shakti free bus travel in its first year?
x: Stree Shakti recorded about 87 crore trips in its first year (to 15 August 2026).

s: After Mobile Dispensing Units were discontinued, for whom does doorstep ration delivery continue in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Senior citizens (65+) and persons with disabilities
x: Fair Price Shops were restored from 1 June 2025, but doorstep delivery continues for those 65+ and persons with disabilities.

s: Where was Chandranna Vidyut Velugulu, for 24-hour three-phase rural power, launched?
x: It was launched at Kodurupadu ST Colony in Nellore Rural.

s: What is the aim of the Balaji Temple Construction Fund of Andhra Pradesh?
o: One new temple in every Assembly constituency
x: The Balaji Temple Construction Fund is to build one new temple per Assembly constituency.

s: With which leader is 'Adavi Thalli Baata' associated?
x: Adavi Thalli Baata is associated with Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan.

s: What is the monthly NTR Bharosa pension for persons with disabilities in Andhra Pradesh?
x: From July 2024 the pension for persons with disabilities was raised from ₹3,000 to ₹6,000.

s:
Match the following NTR Bharosa pension categories with their monthly amounts:
List-I (Category)
A. Old age
B. Persons with disabilities
C. Fully disabled
D. Dialysis (kidney) patients
List-II (Amount)
1. ₹15,000
2. ₹4,000
3. ₹10,000
4. ₹6,000
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
x: Old age ₹4,000; disabled ₹6,000; fully disabled ₹15,000; dialysis patients ₹10,000.

s: About how many spouses of deceased pensioners were approved for pensions under the spouse category in May 2025?
x: 71,380 spouses were approved; each gets ₹4,000 a month.

s: Under the Trupti Canteens initiative (about 3,000 SHG women running 700 canteens), each woman is expected to earn about how much a month?
x: About 3,000 SHG women are to run 700 canteens, each earning about ₹30,000 a month.

s: What does MLCC, the module launched by MEPMA for urban SHG loans, stand for?
x: MLCC stands for MEPMA Loan Charge Creation. It is the module introduced by MEPMA for urban SHG loan processing, while the other expansions are incorrect.

s: What does MEPMA's LEAP aim to create?
x: LEAP aims at one entrepreneur per household; it was launched at Tadepalli.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about MEPMA's LEAP?
o: It is based on 28.7 lakh women in 2.74 lakh SHGs.
It targets 30,000 women entrepreneurs by 8 June 2025.
It aims at one entrepreneur per household.
It targets 20,000 scale-up and 10,000 new women entrepreneurs.
x: LEAP's 30,000 target is 10,000 scale-up and 20,000 new entrepreneurs, not the reverse.

s: Under which agency is the Trupti Canteens initiative of Andhra Pradesh implemented?
x: Trupti Canteens are implemented under MEPMA (Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Municipal Areas).

s: Besides 'One Entrepreneur, One Family', with which vision are the AP–UNICEF youth programmes aligned?
x: The programmes are aligned with 'One Entrepreneur, One Family' and Swarna Andhra 2047.

s: Which model is being used as the benchmark for the expanded Annadanam programme in Andhra Pradesh?
x: The Tirumala Vengamamba Annadanam model is the benchmark for the expanded programme. UPSHIFT belongs to the Youth for Social Impact programme, Smart Street is linked to Trupti Canteens, and ZED is an MSME certification.

s: Under the AP–UNICEF youth programmes, which programme is a digital, multilingual platform integrated with Andhra Pradesh’s Naipunyam portal?
x: YouthHub is the digital, multilingual platform integrated with Andhra Pradesh’s Naipunyam portal. Youth for Social Impact and Passport to Earning are separate AP–UNICEF youth programmes, while Smart Street Programme is associated with Trupti Canteens.

s: The Trupti Canteens initiative in Andhra Pradesh is linked to which programme?
x: Trupti Canteens are linked to the Smart Street Programme. YouthHub, Youth for Social Impact and Passport to Earning belong to the AP–UNICEF youth programmes.

s: Which of the following is NOT among MEPMA's four new urban livelihood initiatives?
x: The four initiatives are Rapido, Trupti Hotels, Smart Street and Green Livelihoods; the SHG Profiling App belongs to MEPMA's profiling system.

s: For youth of which age group is 'Passport to Earning', introduced under the Andhra Pradesh–UNICEF MoU, meant?
x: Passport to Earning is for youth aged 15–29, not 18–25.

s: With which vision were the three MoUs signed by MEPMA on 26 August 2025 linked?
x: The three MoUs were linked to the vision “One Family, One Entrepreneur”.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about MEPMA's MoUs with Self-Help Group partners?
o: The MoUs were signed for rural Self-Help Groups
AE Technologies Pvt. Ltd. – certified compostable water bottles
City of Terrace Gardens – home composting and terrace/kitchen gardening in 123 ULBs
Ecolastic Products Pvt. Ltd. – distribution and local manufacture of compostable products
x: The MoUs were signed with partners for urban Self-Help Groups, not rural ones.

s: From 1 June, which SHG loans are to be processed only through MEPMA's MLCC app?
o: Both urban and rural SHG loans
x: All urban SHG loans, not rural ones, were to be processed through the MLCC app from 1 June.

s: What is the full form of MEPMA?
o: Mission for Empowerment of Poor in Municipal Areas
Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Mandal Areas
Municipal Employment and Poverty Mitigation Agency
Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Municipal Areas
x: MEPMA = Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Municipal Areas.

s: Through which bodies does MEPMA in Andhra Pradesh work with the urban poor?
x: MEPMA serves the urban poor through SHGs and works through ULBs, not rural bodies.

s: Who is the partner of MEPMA's LEAP (Livelihoods & Entrepreneurship Acceleration Plan), launched at Tadepalli on 10 April 2025?
x: LEAP aims at one entrepreneur per household, with India SME Forum as partner.

s: Where was the first Trupti canteen run by MEPMA women inaugurated?
x: MA&UD Minister Dr Ponguru Narayana opened the first Trupti canteen at Atmakur Bus Stand Centre, Nellore.

s: Polam Pilustondi programme of Andhra Pradesh Government aims at
The November 2025 proposal for three new districts – Polavaram, Markapuram and Madanapalle – would take Andhra Pradesh's districts from 26 to how many?
x: Three new districts would raise the count from 26 to 29.

s: Which one of the following statements regarding the e-Panta Digital Crop Survey arrangements for Kharif 2025 is incorrect?
o: NIC built a new module for the survey.
The new module was given to Rythu Seva Kendras.
The deadline for the survey was 30 October 2025.
The new module was given to Urban Local Bodies.
x: The incorrect statement is that the new module was given to Urban Local Bodies. NIC built the module and provided it to Rythu Seva Kendras; the deadline was 30 October 2025.

s: According to the AP Cashew Manufacturers' Association, what is the yield of the Cambodian M23 cashew variety?
x: M23 yields about 1.5 tonnes per acre, against 0.5 tonnes per acre for local cashew.

s: Which country, visited by an APEDA–AICA delegation, is the second-largest producer of raw cashew nuts?
x: Cambodia is the second-largest raw cashew nut producer, and the APEDA–AICA delegation visited it.

s: Under Andhra Pradesh’s modified livestock insurance scheme under the National Livestock Mission, which combination is correct for cattle and buffaloes?
x: Cattle and buffaloes receive three-year insurance cover at a premium of 6.40%. The other options combine the sheep, goat and pig premium rates or coverage periods with cattle and buffaloes.

s: In the committee for the Uppada fishermen's grievances, which pair (member – role) is correctly matched?
o: Commissioners of Industries and Fisheries – Member-Convener
Member-Secretary, AP Pollution Control Board – Nominated by the Collector
x: The Kakinada Collector is Member-Convener; the Commissioners are members, the PCB Member-Secretary is Member-Secretary and fishing representatives are nominated by the Collector.

s: What did the Centre approve in response to Andhra Pradesh's request concerning the e-Panta Digital Crop Survey for Kharif 2025?
o: Exemption of all agricultural and cultivable land
Exemption of non-agricultural and non-cultivable land
x: The Centre approved exemption of non-agricultural and non-cultivable land from the e-Panta Digital Crop Survey for Kharif 2025. Urban land and canal land were among the types included in the largely unregistered parcels, but the approval was not limited to either category.

s: What significant approval concerning Indian prawns was announced by AP IT & HRD Minister Nara Lokesh during his Australia tour in October 2025?
o: Australia's first approval for unpeeled Indian prawns
Australia's first approval for processed Indian fish oils
The United States' first approval for unpeeled Indian prawns
Australia's first approval for Indian aquaculture equipment
x: Australia granted its first approval for unpeeled Indian prawns, as announced by Nara Lokesh during his Australia tour. The United States is not associated with this approval; it had imposed steep tariffs on Indian prawns.

s: Australia's first approval for unpeeled Indian prawns was reported as a boost to which sector of Andhra Pradesh?
x: The approval was reported as a boost for coastal Andhra Pradesh aquaculture.

s: What does APSADA stand for in the context of support for Andhra Pradesh aqua farmers?
o: Andhra Pradesh State Agricultural Development Authority
Andhra Pradesh State Aquaculture Development Agency
Andhra Pradesh Small Aqua Development Association
Andhra Pradesh State Fisheries and Dairies Agency
x: APSADA stands for Andhra Pradesh State Aquaculture Development Agency. The other three expansions are incorrect versions of the organisation's name.

s: As on 31 December 2025, the number of districts in Andhra Pradesh increased from 26 to how many?
x: Two new districts took the total from 26 to 28, and the boundaries of 17 districts changed.

s: Under the APSADA Act amendment, what is the licence validity for aquaculture farming activities?
x: Farming activities get five-year validity, while business operations get one year.

s: Under the APSADA Act amendment, what late fee, besides the licence fee, is payable to endorse old registrations?
x: A 50% late fee plus the licence fee lets about 20% of farmers regularise old registrations.

s: Andhra Pradesh's P4 programme is linked with which Sustainable Development Goal?
x: P4 is linked with SDG 1, No Poverty, not SDG 2.

s: Rythanna Meekosam was a farmer outreach programme in Andhra Pradesh to promote farming based on which framework?
x: Rythanna Meekosam promoted Panchasutra-based farming, with officials visiting every farming household.

s: Under the linked initiatives of Rythanna Meekosam, which facility was associated with certified natural produce?
x: Rythu Bazaars were identified for certified natural produce. Gromor centres were associated with cheaper fertilisers, while Rythu Seva Kendras and District Industries Centres have different roles.

s: Under the AIC–Andhra Pradesh Grameena Bank MoU signed in Guntur, how will shrimp insurance products be sold?
o: Through APGB rural branches under a bancassurance model
x: The MoU adopts a bancassurance model under which AIC's shrimp insurance is sold through APGB rural branches.

s: Which is Principle 2 of the Panchasutra of Rythanna Meekosam?
x: Principle 2 is demand-based cropping; Principle 1 is water security, 3 agritech, 4 food processing.

s: How many Farmer Champions are selected under the SPSR Nellore initiative?
x: One lead farmer per panchayat across 722 gram panchayats in 37 mandals gives 722 Farmer Champions.

s: Under the AP Fisheries Department's 'Super GST – Super Savings' programme, to what rate was GST on key fisheries items reduced from 12%?
x: GST on items such as marine products, processed fish, shrimp and aquaculture equipment was cut from 12% to 5%.

s: What change did Budget 2025–26 make to the customs duty on fish feed, shrimp feed and other aquaculture inputs?
x: Budget 2025–26 reduced customs duty on fish and shrimp feed and other aquaculture inputs to support the sector.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the AIC–APGB shrimp insurance initiative?
o: The cover includes shrimp losses from diseases, cyclones and poor water quality
The future plan is to introduce livestock insurance
The Agriculture Insurance Company of India functions under the Ministry of Finance
Andhra Pradesh accounts for 30–35% of India's shrimp production
x: Andhra Pradesh's share of India's shrimp production is 35–40%, not 30–35%.

s: Which bank sponsors Andhra Pradesh Grameena Bank, a Regional Rural Bank?
x: APGB is sponsored by Union Bank of India; the Agriculture Insurance Company of India was only its MoU partner.

s: What support is given under the 'Farmer Champions' initiative in SPSR Nellore district?
o: Training, modern machinery, post-harvest techniques and CSR support
x: Farmer Champions provides training, modern machinery, post-harvest techniques and CSR support.

s: Under Andhra Pradesh's modified livestock insurance scheme (National Livestock Mission), the farmer pays what share of the premium?
x: The farmer pays 15%; the remaining 85% is shared by the Centre and State in a 60:40 ratio.

s: What was the aim of Polam Pilustondi, launched in August 2014?
